page.overview:
Who is "Soo-Soo"?

was a Harkonnen agent and Guild bank representative who took part in the Banquet House Atreides arranged for the Houses Minor of Arrakis. Due to his position as financial advisor to the Water Peddlers Union he had earned the nickname "Soo-Soo",

The Dune CCG gives the character's real name as "Nejhre".
